item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
Meena's mother is preparing a meal for her son Arjun, who plays kabaddi in the school team. She wants the food to help him build muscles and support proper growth and development.

Which of the following should she include in the meal, and why?

options.A: Dal (pulses) and paneer, because proteins are needed for muscle building, growth and development, and are obtained from both plants and animals.
options.B: Only rice and potatoes, because proteins give instant energy, so they can be replaced by any energy-giving food.
options.C: Only milk and eggs, because proteins useful for growth come only from animal sources, never from plants.
options.D: Sugar and ghee, because any amount of protein-rich food is unnecessary for a growing child.
